title: Local Business (LocalBusiness) Structured Data | Google Search Central  |  Documentation  |  Google for Developers

facts.fact: Google's Restaurant carousel for Local Business structured data is limited to a small set of restaurant providers, and providers must register interest through a form to participate.
facts.quote: The Restaurant carousel is limited to a small set of restaurant providers. If you would like to participate, register your interest in our form.

facts.fact: Google's guidance says non-critical issues flagged by the Rich Results Test are not required for rich results eligibility, though fixing them can improve structured data quality.
facts.quote: Consider also fixing any non-critical issues that may be flagged in the tool, as they can help improve the quality of your structured data (however, this isn't necessary to be eligible for rich results).

facts.fact: Google requires that pages with structured data be accessible to Google and not blocked by robots.txt, the noindex tag, or login requirements, as checked with the URL Inspection tool.
facts.quote: Be sure that your page is accessible to Google and not blocked by a robots.txt file, the noindex tag, or login requirements.

facts.fact: Excluding the validFrom and validThrough properties in openingHoursSpecification signifies that the business hours are valid year-round.
facts.quote: Excluding the `validFrom` and `validThrough` properties signify that the hours are valid year-round.

facts.fact: To show a business as open 24 hours a day, set the opens property to "00:00" and the closes property to "23:59".
facts.quote: set the `open` property to "00:00" and the `closes` property to "23:59".

facts.fact: To show a business as closed all day, set both the opens and closes properties to "00:00".
facts.quote: To show a business is closed all day, set both `opens` and `closes` properties to "00:00".

facts.fact: Seasonal business hours are defined by using both the validFrom and validThrough properties.
facts.quote: Use both the `validFrom` and `validThrough` properties to define seasonal hours.

facts.fact: The seasonal hours example in the Google documentation uses a validFrom date of 2015-12-23 and a validThrough date of 2016-01-05 for a winter holiday closure.
For hours past midnight, opening and closing hours are defined using a single OpeningHoursSpecification property, as shown in the example of Saturday 18:00 until Sunday 03:00.
facts.quote: For hours past midnight, define opening and closing hours using a single `OpeningHoursSpecification` property.

facts.fact: The Restaurant carousel is currently limited to a small set of restaurant providers.
facts.quote: The Restaurant carousel is currently limited to a small set of restaurant providers.

facts.fact: The Local Business required properties listed by Google are address and name.
facts.quote: You must include the required properties for your content to be eligible for display as a rich result.

facts.fact: If a business has multiple types, they must be specified as an array, and additionalType is not supported.
facts.quote: If you have multiple types, specify them as an array (`additionalType` isn't supported).

facts.fact: For the address property, Google recommends including as many PostalAddress properties as possible, since more properties produce a higher-quality result.
facts.quote: Include as many properties as possible. The more properties you provide, the higher quality the result is to users.

facts.fact: Google's guidelines state that businesses must follow the listed guidelines to be eligible to appear in Local Business rich results.
facts.quote: You must follow these guidelines to be eligible to appear in Local Business rich results.

facts.fact: For businesses with departments that have distinct properties such as hours or telephone numbers, each department can be marked up with its own element under the department property.
facts.quote: you can mark up the `department` property with an element for each department.

facts.fact: For LocalBusiness structured data, the geo.latitude and geo.longitude values must have a precision of at least 5 decimal places.
facts.quote: The precision must be at least 5 decimal places.

facts.fact: Google will not show a price range for a business if the priceRange text is 100 characters or longer; the field must be shorter than 100 characters.
facts.quote: This field must be shorter than 100 characters. If it's 100 characters or longer, Google won't show a price range for the business.

facts.fact: The openingHoursSpecification.closes time must be in hh:mm:ss format.
facts.quote: The time the business location closes, in hh:mm:ss format.

facts.fact: The openingHoursSpecification.opens time must be in hh:mm:ss format.
facts.quote: The time the business location opens, in hh:mm:ss format.

facts.fact: Seasonal closure dates for openingHoursSpecification.validFrom and validThrough must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
facts.quote: The start date of a seasonal business closure, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

facts.fact: For restaurant carousel eligibility, Google recommends multiple high-resolution images with a minimum of 50K pixels when multiplying width and height.
facts.quote: multiple high-resolution images (minimum of 50K pixels when multiplying width and height)

facts.fact: For restaurant carousel images, Google recommends providing images with aspect ratios of 16x9, 4x3, and 1x1.
facts.quote: we recommend providing multiple high-resolution images (minimum of 50K pixels when multiplying width and height) with the following aspect ratios: 16x9, 4x3, and 1x1.

facts.fact: The telephone property should include the country code and area code in the phone number.
facts.quote: Be sure to include the country code and area code in the phone number.

facts.fact: For a department nested under a store, the department name should be formatted as '{store name} {department name}', unless the department name is explicitly branded.
facts.quote: Include the store name with the department name in the following format: `{store name} {department name}`.

facts.fact: The aggregateRating and review properties are only recommended for sites that capture reviews about other local businesses.
facts.quote: This property is only recommended for sites that capture reviews about other local businesses

facts.fact: Google notes it may take several days after publishing a page for Google to find and crawl it.
facts.quote: it may take several days after publishing a page for Google to find and crawl it.

facts.fact: Google does not guarantee that features consuming structured data will show up in search results.
facts.quote: Google does not guarantee that features that consume structured data will show up in search results.
